shapes.author: agent
shapes.text:
classify() reads argv and repo configs, never runs them: session > container >
headless, plus a refuse flag. run() refuses that on every lane, and a forced
headless downgrade, else calls the lane's run(). Cloud: a box's ≤25 s claim
long-poll takes a waiting sandbox first, else the fairest task.

shapes.author: agent
shapes.text:
Local: each run gets .offstage/runs/<id>/ (command.log, screen.png,
result.json); a failed write adds a diagnostic, never changes the verdict. Plane:
in-memory stores snapshot atomically to /data/plane.json every 2 s if changed
and on SIGTERM; in-flight sandbox ops are lost on restart.
